about:
US Advanced Medical Research, Inc., based in Henderson, Nevada, was founded in 1988 by Dr. Brian Jegasothy, Dr. Lingam, and Alice Thiel. The trio—dermatologists, Ayurvedic practitioners, and cosmetic scientists with over 200 years of combined expertise—created the Hylunia brand to develop clean, anti-inflammatory skincare that prevents inflammaging and slows skin aging.

The company formulates and manufactures its own product line—including serums, creams, lotions, and mists—using plant-based hyaluronic acid, green tea, turmeric, neem, and vitamin C. Production runs in small batches at the Henderson facility to maintain freshness. The operation serves more than 1,000 professional spas nationwide and has sold over 5 million units to date.

Hylunia products target professional aestheticians, dermatology offices, and spa retailers, as well as direct consumers seeking solutions for age-delay, lift and firm, brightening, oily and acne-prone skin, rosacea and redness, and dark circles. The brand is positioned in the professional skincare, spa and wellness, and anti-aging cosmetics markets.

The founders built the company on a prevention-first philosophy, fusing Ayurvedic tradition with modern clinical research to soothe oxidative stress and support the skin's natural recovery. Every formulation avoids parabens, sulfates, synthetic fragrances, and endocrine disruptors, reflecting a commitment to safety and efficacy that the company says sets it apart.
